Title: Semester 1 Lectures Start
Description: Semester 1 lectures start for all students on Monday 03 August 2026.

Title: Semester 1 Module Registration Deadline
Description: The deadline for exemption applications, self-study applications, change of modules, withdrawal from modules and end of module registration for Semester 1 is Friday 21 August 2026.

Title: Semester 1 Floating Week
Description: Floating Week for assessments, lectures, tutorials and catch-up lectures takes place from Monday 07 September 2026 to Saturday 12 September 2026.

Title: Semester 1 Late Registration Deadline
Description: The last date for late module registration or de-registration upon payment of a penalty fee is Friday 25 September 2026.

Title: Semester 1 Examination Period
Description: Semester 1 examinations start on Tuesday 03 November 2026 and end on Saturday 28 November 2026.

Title: Semester 2 Induction Period
Description: Induction for new entrants takes place from Monday 11 January 2027 to Friday 15 January 2027.

Title: Semester 2 Lectures Start
Description: Semester 2 lectures start for all students on Monday 18 January 2027.

Title: Semester 2 Module Registration Deadline
Description: The end of module registration for Semester 2 is Friday 05 February 2027.

Title: Students Week
Description: Students' Week takes place from Monday 29 March 2027 to Saturday 03 April 2027. No lectures are held during Students' Week.

Title: Semester 2 Revision Weeks
Description: Semester 2 Revision Weeks take place from Monday 12 April 2027 to Saturday 24 April 2027.

Title: Semester 2 Examination Period
Description: Semester 2 examinations start on Monday 26 April 2027 and end on Saturday 22 May 2027.

Title: Graduation Ceremonies 2027
Description: University of Mauritius graduation ceremonies and sessions are scheduled during March and April 2027.

Title: Library Opening Hours During Term Time
Description: During term time, the UoM Library is open Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 17:00 and Saturday from 08:00 to 13:00.

Title: Library Opening Hours During Vacation
Description: During the vacation period, the UoM Library is open Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 16:00 and Saturday from 08:00 to 12:00.

Title: Undergraduate Library Borrowing Allowance
Description: Undergraduate students may borrow up to 3 books, including 1 book from the Reserve Section.

Title: Academic Staff Library Borrowing Allowance
Description: Academic Staff may borrow up to 6 books, including 2 books from the Reserve Section.

Title: MPhil and PhD Library Borrowing Allowance
Description: MPhil and PhD students may borrow up to 5 books, including 1 book from the Reserve Section.

Title: Law Student Library Borrowing Allowance
Description: Law students may borrow up to 3 books, including 1 book from the Reserve Section.

Title: Non-Academic Staff Library Borrowing Allowance
Description: Non-Academic Staff may borrow up to 1 book.

Title: Main CITS Computer Lab Location
Description: The main CITS Computer Lab is located in the Ex-Student Common Room, First Floor, VCILT Building.

Title: CITS Labs 1A 1B and 1C Location
Description: CITS Labs 1A, 1B and 1C are located in the Phase II Engineering Building.

Title: Other CITS and Faculty Computer Labs
Description: The CITS FSSH Lab is on the Ground Floor of the Faculty of Social Sciences and Humanities Building. CITS FOA Lab 1A is on the First Floor of the Faculty of Agriculture Building. CITS FOA Lab 2A is on the Second Floor of the Faculty of Agriculture Building. CITS ETB Lab and the Bioinformatics Lab are on the First Floor of the Prof E. Lim Fat Building. The CITS Ebene Core Lab is on the second floor of The Core Building, Ebene.

Title: UoM Online Credit Card Payment
Description: University fees may be paid through the UoM Pay Online portal using a credit card in Mauritian Rupees or US Dollars.

Title: MCB Direct Transfer for UoM Payments
Description: Payments may be made to the Mauritius Commercial Bank UoM Bank Account. The account number is 000142555444. Payments may be made through MCB Internet Banking and the MCB JUICE mobile app.

Title: SBM Mauritian Rupee Account for UoM Payments
Description: The SBM Bank Mauritius account for payments in Mauritian Rupees has account number 62025100002399 and may be accessed through SBM Internet Banking.

Title: SBM US Dollar Account for UoM Payments
Description: The SBM Bank Mauritius account for payments in US Dollars has account number 61026000014607.

Title: UoM Digital and Mobile Payment Applications
Description: Digital and mobile payment applications accepted by UoM include my.t Billpay through the my.t money mobile application and the BLINK mobile payment application.
